summary: Legacy VB6 application with significant modernization challenges. Modern Python agent system shows good architectural patterns but lacks comprehensive testing coverage.

hotspots.reason: Direct ADO usage without parameterized queries creates SQL injection risk
Business logic embedded in UI event handlers reduces testability and maintainability
Inconsistent error handling patterns across agent implementations
53 schema files indicate comprehensive validation but may create maintenance overhead

provenance.evidence: 53 config files with JSON schema format

risks.title: SQL Injection Vulnerability
risks.description: VB6 application uses ADO without parameterized queries, creating potential for SQL injection attacks

risks.title: Data Migration Complexity
risks.description: MS Access to PostgreSQL migration requires careful schema mapping and data type conversion

risks.title: Business Logic Preservation
risks.description: VB6 form event handlers contain undocumented business rules that must be preserved during modernization

risks.title: Agent System Scalability
risks.description: Python agent system lacks distributed processing capabilities for large-scale modernization projects
